set.body:
Phase D (architecture; one API-churn window). THE key revision to settle before 1.0.

Problem: core/Scheduler.scala:12 is

    def submit[A](request: JobRequest[A]): F[SubmissionAttempt]

A is phantom at the interface — accepted but never honored. Over SSH, ssh/Slurm.scala:263 lowers to an exit-only script request. The managed controller persists only JobRequest[NoResult]. The signature promises a typed relationship the scheduler cannot keep.

Fix: Scheduler[F] accepts a type-erased LaunchSpec. Typed preparation moves above the scheduler (P8.D2).

Why this must precede codec ownership (P6f.12): hand-writing every public codec against JobRequest[A] and then reshaping to LaunchSpec means writing them twice. EPIC P7 already established "representation before codecs"; this bead is the generalization — SHAPE before representation before codecs.

Acceptance: Scheduler carries no phantom type parameter; one lowering representation shared by typed tasks, scripts, arrays, remote attachment and durable managed execution — NOT a second scheduler algebra and NOT separate batch and task IRs.
set.title: P8.D1: Type-erased Scheduler.submit(LaunchSpec)
